_note: Canonical benchmark dashboard for the reader-facing Benchmark Compass. Scores are normalized to 0-100 with visible methodology; raw values remain visible so the composite is explainable.

composite.name: Benchmark Compass
composite.method: Weighted normalized benchmark basket. METR gets the largest weight because task time horizon is the most human-legible proxy for autonomy.

benchmarks.label: METR 50% time horizon
benchmarks.note: METR's May 2026 page says Claude Mythos Preview reaches the current suite's >16h unreliable-measurement zone. Treat as at-least-16h, not exact.

benchmarks.label: ARC-AGI-2
benchmarks.note: Still below saturation; good counterweight to over-reading coding/autonomy gains.

benchmarks.label: SWE-bench Pro
benchmarks.note: Coding benchmark signal; not equivalent to autonomous project completion.

benchmarks.label: WildClawBench
benchmarks.note: Agent harness benchmark; sensitive to scaffold and tool policy.

benchmarks.label: FrontierMath
benchmarks.note: Estimated project snapshot; must be replaced with direct leaderboard/source when available.

benchmarks.label: Open-frontier Elo gap
benchmarks.note: Smaller gap is better; score is inverted-normalized.

reliability_modes.label: 50% success
reliability_modes.caveat: Current METR suite becomes unreliable above 16h; treat today's value as a lower bound.

reliability_modes.label: 80% success
reliability_modes.caveat: 80% horizon is an estimate derived from the lower-reliability curve shape; render as estimated until primary values are available.
